name: Zabbix
description: Zabbix monitoring: hosts, host groups, items, triggers, active problems, events and the latest measured values. JSON-RPC API over a single endpoint, bearer API token.
instructions:
**Getting a token** (Zabbix 5.4 and newer)
1. Sign in to the Zabbix frontend as a Super admin and open **Users → API tokens**.
2. Create a token for a user with read permission on the host groups the agent should see, and copy the value — Zabbix shows it once.
3. Set `ZABBIX_URL` to your frontend root (no trailing slash, no `/api_jsonrpc.php`) and `ZABBIX_API_TOKEN` to the token. The adapter sends it as `Authorization: Bearer …`, which Zabbix 6.0+ accepts; on 5.4 the token also works in the JSON-RPC `auth` field, which this adapter does not use.

**One endpoint, many methods.** Zabbix is JSON-RPC: every call is a POST to `/api_jsonrpc.php` with `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"host.get","params":{…},"id":1}`. That is why every tool here has the same path, and why the *method* is what distinguishes them.

**Permissions are per host group, and Zabbix reports a denial as an empty array.** A token whose user cannot see a host group gets `{"result": []}` rather than an error — so an agent that reports 'no problems' may simply be looking through an account with no visibility.

**Severity is an integer.** 0 not classified, 1 information, 2 warning, 3 average, 4 high, 5 disaster. 'Critical alerts' usually means severity ≥ 4.

**`problem.get` is the live board, `event.get` is the history.** A problem that has since resolved is gone from `problem.get` and still in `event.get`. Ask the right one.

**Timestamps are Unix seconds**, in the server's timezone configuration.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch, and a homelab's default certificate is exactly the case that breaks.
- On an internal host (`zabbix.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: zabbix_get_api_version
tools.description: Read the Zabbix API version. The one method that needs no authentication at all — use it to separate a URL problem from a token problem.

tools.name: zabbix_list_hosts
tools.description: List monitored hosts with their name, status, interfaces and host groups. The map of what Zabbix is actually watching.

groupids.description: Restrict to these host group ids.

search_name.description: Name fragment to search for (wildcard match).

tools.name: zabbix_list_host_groups
tools.description: List host groups with their id, name and the number of hosts in each. Needed to scope any other query to a part of the estate.

tools.name: zabbix_list_problems
tools.description: List the problems that are active **right now**, with their severity, host, name and the time they started. This is the live alert board.

severities.description: Severity levels to include: 0 not classified, 1 information, 2 warning, 3 average, 4 high, 5 disaster.

groupids.description: Restrict to these host group ids.

recent.description: When true, also include recently resolved problems.

tools.name: zabbix_list_events
tools.description: List events from the history — including problems that have since resolved, which problem.get no longer shows. The tool for 'what happened last night'.

tools.name: zabbix_list_triggers
tools.description: List triggers with their expression, severity, current value and the host they belong to — the rules that turn measurements into problems.

only_true.description: When true, only triggers currently in a problem state.

tools.name: zabbix_list_items
tools.description: List monitored items with their key, name, type, value type and units — what Zabbix actually measures on a host.

search_key.description: Item key fragment to search for, e.g. vfs.fs.size.

tools.name: zabbix_get_latest_values
tools.description: Read the most recent value of specific items — the current disk usage, load average or temperature, rather than the alert about it.

itemids.description: Item ids to read, from zabbix_list_items.

hostids.description: Or read every item on these hosts.

tools.name: zabbix_get_history
tools.description: Read historical values of one item over a time range — the series behind a graph. Pass the right history type or Zabbix returns nothing.

history.description: Value type: 0 float, 1 character, 2 log, 3 unsigned integer, 4 text. Must match the item's value_type.

time_from.description: Start of the range, Unix seconds.

time_till.description: End of the range, Unix seconds.

tools.name: zabbix_list_maintenance_windows
tools.description: List configured maintenance windows with their hosts, groups and periods — the explanation for why an alert did not fire.
